summary: Shimmick Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a 3,730,000-share common stock offering at $3.50 per share, with an underwriter option for 559,500 additional shares. The filing is a routine follow-on public offering under an existing S-3 shelf registration. Proceeds to the company are $3.29 per share before expenses, and the offering is expected to close on May 26, 2026. There is no special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign; this is an ordinary capital raise by the issuer.
